BackstoryDef.title: Mysterious Stranger
BackstoryDef.description: You have a Guardian Angel, but with a deadly hand-cannon instead of wings. Meet the Mysterious Stranger, an odd and eldritch entity said to appear and aid you in combat before you draw your dying breath.

BackstoryDef.title: Wandering Ranger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of the elite fighting force that joined the NCR, the Desert Rangers. [PAWN_pronoun] excels in ranged combat and has quite a few other survival skills, owed to years of service in and around the wasteland. [PAWN_nameDef] hasn't always made the smartest choices, but always seems to talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of trouble. With a revolver and a smolder [PAWN_nameDef] wanders the wastes looking for the next settlement to help, and accidently bring into harms way...

BackstoryDef.title: Crystal Sparkle
BackstoryDef.description: Crystal Sparkle was born in pre-war China and immigrated to America with dreams of becoming a doctor. She was studying medicine and performing as an amateur magician when the Great War began, and the bombs turned her world to ash. Exposed to extreme radiation, she became a glowing one, her body forever changed but her mind intact. Despite her ghoulified state, Crystal dedicated herself to helping others in the wasteland, using her medical knowledge and sleight-of-hand tricks to bring hope and wonder to those in need. She met Ranger Rick after patching him up from a deadly ambush, and the two have been inseparable ever since. Her glowing aura is both a beacon of hope and a danger in the unforgiving wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Food and Supplies Merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] became a lifeline for many in the Capital Wasteland, running a caravan that specialized in food, water, and essential supplies. Known for [PAWN_possessive] resourcefulness and compassion, Angela Staley always tried to help those in need, even when it meant risking her own safety. Her caravan was a welcome sight for hungry settlers and desperate wanderers alike, and her reputation for fairness and kindness spread far and wide.

BackstoryDef.title: Helpful Scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was always looking out for others, sharing what little [PAWN_pronoun] could find with friends and family. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to scavenge for edible plants, clean water, and safe places to rest, often putting [PAWN_objective]self last to make sure others were cared for. Angela's early years taught her the value of kindness and the importance of a full belly in the harsh wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Council Representative
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sits on the Rivet City Council as the voice of its civilian population, a young but shrewd businessman who earned his seat as much through sharp dealing as public trust. In addition to [PAWN_possessive] council duties, Bannon runs a well-stocked clothing shop, providing quality apparel to settlers and travelers alike at prices that reflect having no real competition.

BackstoryDef.title: Resourceful Youth
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up in the ruins of the old world, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to solve problems and mediate disputes from a young age. [PAWN_pronoun] was always the one to organize games, share food, and help others find shelter. Bannon's early experiences taught [PAWN_objective] the value of cooperation, quick thinking, and looking out for the group above all else.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Bar Owner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran the Muddy Rudder, Rivet City's most popular bar, serving drinks and advice to settlers, drifters, and security alike. Known for [PAWN_possessive] sharp wit, no-nonsense attitude, and ability to keep order even when things got rowdy, Belle Bonny was the heart of the city's nightlife. [PAWN_pronoun] knew everyone's secrets and always had an ear to the ground for the latest gossip.

BackstoryDef.title: Resourceful Scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up in the Capital Wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] learned to make do with whatever [PAWN_pronoun] could find. [PAWN_pronoun] was quick with a joke, good at making friends, and always found a way to get what [PAWN_pronoun] needed, whether that was food, shelter, or a little extra fun. Belle's early years taught [PAWN_objective] the value of resourcefulness and a sharp tongue.

BackstoryDef.title: Armor and Apparel Trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] makes [PAWN_possessive] living by selling apparel, clothing and armor to the people of the wastes. Having grown up and lived as a tribal before giving up the "loincloth" [PAWN_nameDef] speaks in a broken almost mystic version of enlgish. While [PAWN_pronoun] likes to thank the spirits, [PAWN_pronoun] knows that "a cold, hard skin of steel" is the most reliable option.

BackstoryDef.title: Crows' Childhood
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a born tribal of the Capitol Wasteland. Not much is known about [PAWN_nameDef] except a wild speculation that [PAWN_pronoun] is from Oasis. A small unassuming and quite curious settlement of near fanatical cultists.

BackstoryDef.title: Junk Trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the Capital Wasteland's most eccentric junk trader, known for his wild stories, rambling sales pitches, and a caravan bursting with oddities. With a manic grin and a love for all things scrap, Crazy Wolfgang travels the wastes in search of the next big haul, or at least the next person willing to buy a toaster, a lawnmower blade, or a perfectly good hunk of pre-war junk. Some say he's a little unhinged, but his eye for valuable salvage is unmatched.

BackstoryDef.title: Crazy Wolfgangs' Childhood
BackstoryDef.description: Even as a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was obsessed with collecting odd bits and pieces from the ruins of the old world. While other kids played with toys, [PAWN_pronoun] built elaborate contraptions out of scrap, broken radios, and bottle caps. [PAWN_nameDef]'s wild imagination and endless curiosity made [PAWN_objective] a fixture at every junk pile in the settlement, and [PAWN_pronoun] was always ready with a wild story about [PAWN_possessive] latest find.

BackstoryDef.title: Traveling Chem Dealer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wandered the Capital Wasteland as a traveling doctor and chem dealer, peddling medicine and chems to anyone with the caps. Known for [PAWN_possessive] dry wit, questionable medical ethics, and a tendency to sample [PAWN_possessive] own wares, Doc Hoff was always ready with a remedy for pain, or with a new addiction. [PAWN_pronoun] could patch up a bullet wound or sell you a dose of Jet, all with the same sly grin.

BackstoryDef.title: Curious Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was always poking around old ruins and abandoned clinics, fascinated by bottles, syringes, and anything labeled "medicine." [PAWN_pronoun] was quick to learn first aid, sometimes on the family Brahmin, and had a knack for mixing up strange brews from whatever [PAWN_pronoun] could scavenge. Rules were more like suggestions, and [PAWN_nameDef] was always in trouble for "borrowing" supplies for [PAWN_possessive] experiments.

BackstoryDef.title: Weapon Merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] earned the nickname "Lucky" by surviving countless close calls on the treacherous roads of the Capital Wasteland. As a traveling weapons merchant, [PAWN_pronoun] always had a story about a narrow escape or a big score, and [PAWN_possessive] caravan was famous for its ever-changing arsenal. With a quick wit, a gambler's charm, and a knack for finding rare firepower, Lucky Harith could arm a settlement just as easily as [PAWN_pronoun] could talk [PAWN_objective]self out of a firefight.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Gambler
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up, [PAWN_nameDef] was always taking chances, sneaking into forbidden ruins, betting bottle caps on two-headed ant races, or trading scavenged goods for a shot at something better. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that luck could be as valuable as skill, and [PAWN_pronoun] was quick to make friends (and the occasional enemy) wherever [PAWN_pronoun] roamed. Every close call was just another story to tell around the campfire.

BackstoryDef.title: Solitary Scrap Trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hauls a battered cart of salvage across the wasteland alone, trusting nothing but [PAWN_possessive] own two hands and a loyal brahmin to watch [PAWN_possessive] back. Too stubborn to travel with guards and too sharp-tongued to need them, [PAWN_nameDef] has turned other people's trash into a business that's outlasted merchants twice [PAWN_possessive] size. Settlements know [PAWN_objective] as gruff, blunt, and always fair on a trade.

BackstoryDef.title: Junkyard Upbringing
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up picking through scrapyards and collapsed buildings, learning to spot the one usable part in a heap of ruin. Nobody looked out for [PAWN_objective], but [PAWN_pronoun] never seemed to need it. [PAWN_pronoun] could talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of trouble as easily as [PAWN_pronoun] could fix a broken axle.

BackstoryDef.title: Arms Dealer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] deals guns and ammunition to whoever can pay, and doesn't much care to be lectured about it. Loud, foul-mouthed, and quick to anger, [PAWN_pronoun] has survived raiders, super mutants, and worse by never being caught without a loaded weapon in reach. Despite the temper, [PAWN_possessive] prices are honest and [PAWN_possessive] stock is always current.

BackstoryDef.title: Raider Camp Runaway
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a raider camp and learned to strip and load a gun before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read. [PAWN_pronoun] fled the first chance [PAWN_pronoun] got, taking a bag of ammunition with [PAWN_objective] and a grudge against anyone who tries to push [PAWN_objective] around.

BackstoryDef.title: Traveling Peddler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took up [PAWN_possessive] mother's trade route after she passed, and has been nervously making the rounds ever since. Still young and still learning the trade, [PAWN_pronoun] makes up for [PAWN_possessive] inexperience with earnest honesty and a genuine want to help settlers get what they need, even if it means haggling badly against [PAWN_possessive] own interest.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up riding on the back of a supply cart, watching [PAWN_possessive] mother trade with every settlement along the route. [PAWN_pronoun] learned [PAWN_possessive] numbers counting caps and [PAWN_possessive] manners greeting strangers at gunpoint with a smile instead of a weapon.

BackstoryDef.title: Traveling Chem Dealer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] roams the wasteland with a case of medicine and a well-worn bedside manner, tending to whoever can pay and quietly helping the ones who can't. Calm under pressure and slow to judge, [PAWN_pronoun] has patched up settlers, raiders, and everything between, and asks few questions in return.

BackstoryDef.title: Settlement Healer's Apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood fetching bandages and boiling water for the settlement healer, soaking up every lesson [PAWN_pronoun] could. By the time [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to travel, [PAWN_pronoun] already knew more about stitching a wound than most grown wastelanders ever would.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Security Officer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a security officer in Rivet City, the largest and most advanced settlement in the Capital Wasteland. Tasked with keeping the peace, [PAWN_pronoun] patrolled the ship's decks, enforced the council's laws, and protected residents from raiders and mutants. The job required discipline, vigilance, and a steady hand with a weapon.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Security Veteran
BackstoryDef.description: After years of service, [PAWN_nameDef] became a veteran member of Rivet City's security force. [PAWN_pronoun] had seen it all: mutant attacks, raider incursions, and the daily struggles of keeping order in a floating city. [PAWN_pronoun] was respected by peers for [PAWN_possessive] experience, quick reflexes, and calm under pressure.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Security Rookie
BackstoryDef.description: New to the force, [PAWN_nameDef] joined Rivet City security eager to prove [PAWN_objective]self. Under the watchful eyes of veteran officers, [PAWN_pronoun] learned the ropes: patrolling the ship, breaking up disputes, and facing the dangers of the wasteland for the first time. Every day brought new challenges and valuable lessons.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a farmer. Not many crops grew in the barren, often irradiated, soil of the wasteland, but [PAWN_pronoun] managed to scrape by. Sadly, [PAWN_nameDef] never got a proper education and remained illiterate.

BackstoryDef.title: Sawbones
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was educated in medicine by the Followers of the Apocalypse. Albeit [PAWN_pronoun] never became as skilled a doctor as [PAWN_possessive] tutors, [PAWN_pronoun] knew enough about human anatomy to become a wandering sawbones.

BackstoryDef.title: Moonshiner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has always had a talent for chemistry and decided to put it to good use by making booze. Life in the wasteland is tough and many of its inhabitants need an occasional pick-me-up and [PAWN_nameDef] was willing to provide it… as long as they paid in caps.

BackstoryDef.title: Slaver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a slaver, buying and selling other human beings for profit. While [PAWN_pronoun] managed to become quite wealthy through [PAWN_possessive] trade, [PAWN_pronoun] got used to slaves doing all the menial labor.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravaneer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has seen more of the wasteland than most of its inhabitants, since [PAWN_pronoun] travelled around with a caravan outfit. On the roads of the wasteland [PAWN_pronoun] learned a lot about trading and generally interacting with people, as well as how to tend to the beasts of burden carrying the valuable goods.

BackstoryDef.title: Weapon Artisan
BackstoryDef.description: The hostility of the wasteland and many of its inhabitants, both beasts and humans, make the ability to craft and maintain weaponry indispensable. [PAWN_nameDef] has this gift and used it to look after the equipment of [PAWN_possessive] community.

BackstoryDef.title: Water Merchant
BackstoryDef.description: As much of the wasteland is arid and irradiated, clean water is a precious commodity. [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a merchant specialized in trading water, transporting it from its source to the thirsty settlements of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Roving Trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was roving trader, moving from place to place, never staying long. [PAWN_pronoun] has a way with people and learned some other survival skills while being on the road.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living protecting the caravans of the wasteland. Without the occasional caravan, many settlements in the wasteland couldn’t survive and it was [PAWN_possessive]’s job to make sure they reached their destination.

BackstoryDef.title: Small Time Mercenary
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a small-time mercenary. [PAWN_pronoun] never quite made it to the big league but was nevertheless a capable fighter. [PAWN_pronoun] never lived long in one place, lacking the skills of a homemaker.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Artist
BackstoryDef.description: Unusual for an inhabitant of the wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] always had an eye for aesthetics. While most other wastelanders didn’t mind living in ruined pre-war buildings, [PAWN_nameDef] preferred to decorate [PAWN_possessive] dwelling with pieces of art, either self-made or scavenged ones.

BackstoryDef.title: Settlement Guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a guard in a small, independent settlement. While [PAWN_pronoun] rarely had to deal with bigger threats, there were always dangerous animals which ventured to close to the town and had to be put down.

BackstoryDef.title: Courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a courier for the Mojave Express, or a similar delivery company. To overcome the many dangers of the postapocalyptic wasteland, couriers had to be resilient individuals, capable of putting up a fight against raiders. Furthermore, [PAWN_nameDef] had a set of other survival skills, owed to the fact that [PAWN_pronoun] often lived alone on the road for many weeks.

BackstoryDef.title: Gecko Hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a living by hunting Geckos and other smaller animals of the wasteland for their meat and hides. [PAWN_pronoun] is not only a good hunter but also knows how to maintain [PAWN_possessive] equipment.

BackstoryDef.title: Sheriff
BackstoryDef.description: As [PAWN_pronoun] was always handy with a gun and had a strong sense of justice, the inhabitants of [PAWN_nameDef]’s settlement elected [PAWN_possessive] as the town’s sheriff. Much of the wasteland lacked an organised judicial system but [PAWN_nameDef] was content with enforcing some good old frontier justice.

BackstoryDef.title: Prospector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a scavenger, picking through the remains of pre-war buildings for valuables. It was a hard life and [PAWN_nameDef] had to learn how to fight, as feral ghouls and raiders often lived in the ruins [PAWN_pronoun] searched through.

BackstoryDef.title: Freed Slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once was a slave, liberated by an abolitionist group somewhere in the wasteland. Although [PAWN_nameDef] regained [PAWN_possessive] freedom, enslavement left its marks and made [PAWN_pronoun] unable to enact violence upon others.

BackstoryDef.title: Nuka Cola Fan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always had a fascination for the world-famous pre-war soft drink Nuka-Cola. [PAWN_pronoun] collected everything related to Nuka-Cola and quickly amassed an impressive amount of fan articles and souvenirs.

BackstoryDef.title: Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has had a talent with machinery, both primitive and complex, and managed to repair and maintain it despite often not knowing how exactly it functioned. This made [PAWN_objective] an important member of [PAWN_possessive] community, as trained experts were a rare sight in the wasteland. However, [PAWN_pronoun] was also known as untidy, taking apart machines and leaving the party lying around pretty much everywhere.

BackstoryDef.title: Former Junkie
BackstoryDef.description: There are many different chems in the wasteland, and [PAWN_nameDef] tried most of them at least once. For many years, [PAWN_pronoun] was a junkie, stealing, deceiving and cheating to earn money for the next dose of whatever obnoxious substance [PAWN_pronoun] was hooked on that time. Eventually, [PAWN_nameDef] managed to become clean and move on to begin a new life somewhere else. The long-lasting consumption of dangerous substances did take its toll on [PAWN_possessive] body, however, permanently damaging [PAWN_possessive] kidneys.

BackstoryDef.title: Drifting Musician
BackstoryDef.description: After taking a few jobs here and there, [PAWN_nameDef] decided that a settled life wasn’t the right thing for [PAWN_objective]. Instead, [PAWN_pronoun] hit the road and faced the wasteland with nothing but the clothes on [PAWN_possessive] back and [PAWN_possessive] trusty guitar, wandering from town to town without a clear goal or destination in mind.

BackstoryDef.title: Militia Member
BackstoryDef.description: Regardless of the many larger and well-known political entities and groups which thrived throughout the wasteland, the majority of the humans living in post-war America were part of smaller, more or less independent settlements and groups. Most of these communities didn’t have the means and manpower to operate a standing army and relied on voluntary militias to defend them from outside threats. [PAWN_nameDef] was part of such a militia. Despite the fact that [PAWN_pronoun] never got any real combat training and needed to procure [PAWN_possessive] own equipment, [PAWN_nameDef] was proud to serve a good cause.

BackstoryDef.title: Former Tribal
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent much of [PAWN_possessive] adult life in a tribal-like society. One day [PAWN_pronoun] broke off from [PAWN_possessive] group to explore the world beyond the small tribal homelands. After visiting many different “civilized” settlements in the wasteland [PAWN_nameDef] decided to settle down in a quaint little village. While [PAWN_pronoun] managed to adapt to [PAWN_possessive] new surroundings relatively well, [PAWN_pronoun] remained sceptical towards high-tech technology.

BackstoryDef.title: Radio Presenter
BackstoryDef.description: There were a stunning number of different radio stations throughout the wasteland, albeit most of them had a limited range of reception. [PAWN_nameDef] was the host of one of these radio stations and fulfilled both the role of DJ and news reporter. [PAWN_pronoun] was extremely popular among the comparatively few people who managed to get [PAWN_possessive] radio signal, due to [PAWN_possessive] excellent choice in music. However, [PAWN_nameDef] never got much experience with manual labour.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Butcher
BackstoryDef.description: Like [PAWN_possessive] father, [PAWN_nameDef] became a butcher. The vast majority of people in the post-apocalyptic wasteland couldn’t be picky in their choice of food and [PAWN_nameDef] couldn’t be picky what to butcher and sell to [PAWN_possessive] customers either. Radroaches, molerats, squirrels, bloatflies and iguanas were the among the more affordable foodstuffs. Brahmin and bighorner meats were usually reserved for those with a refined palate. And the necessary caps of course.

BackstoryDef.title: Wandering Priest
BackstoryDef.description: Although most people in the wasteland didn’t have the luxury of free time to ask themselves existential or theological questions, there were exceptions. [PAWN_nameDef] was a wandering priest, traveling from town to town. [PAWN_possessive] goal never was to convert the people of the wasteland to a specific faith, but to give them hope thru giving them something to believe in. [PAWN_nameDef] never got a proper theological education and pasted [PAWN_possessive] faith together from various scriptures [PAWN_pronoun] found in old churches and other temples.

BackstoryDef.title: Children of Atom Preacher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was part of the comparatively young but rapidly growing cult called “The Children of Atom”. This cult worshipped a deity named Atom, and revered radiation and nuclear annihilation as manifestations of their god’s will. They believed, that within every atomic mass in all of creation existed an entire universe and nuclear fission was a divine act of creating new life. [PAWN_nameDef] became part of this cult while [PAWN_pronoun] was searching for meaning in the brutal, unforgiving world that came to be after the great war. Unfortunately for [PAWN_objective] not all wastelanders looked favourably upon such… innovative ideas.

BackstoryDef.title: Water Purifier Worker
BackstoryDef.description: Since clean water was precious in most parts of the wasteland, water purifiers often decided over the live and death of a settlement. Due to [PAWN_possessive] moderate understanding of this incredibly important machine, [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to look after it. To do that properly [PAWN_pronoun] often had to improvise while repairing the water purifier, as the old machine was prone to malfunctions and spare parts were rare.

BackstoryDef.title: Solar Panel Expert
BackstoryDef.description: Usually only the larger settlements were hooked up to a power network, the smaller ones had to help themselves, if they wanted electricity. Pre-war solar arrays were a preferred choice, as they usually generated enough power for a small settlement and were comparatively easy to maintain and repair due to their rugged design. [PAWN_nameDef] was in charge of [PAWN_possessive] settlement’s solar arrays, a job [PAWN_pronoun] took very seriously.

BackstoryDef.title: Roadside Merchant
BackstoryDef.description: Instead of taking the risk of traveling through the wasteland with [PAWN_possessive] wares, [PAWN_nameDef] decided it would be much safer to put up a roadside shop to deal with incoming caravans and travellers. [PAWN_pronoun] managed to get by, but was always wary of raiders, since [PAWN_possessive] business depended on safe roads to travel on.

BackstoryDef.title: Enclave Patriot
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a loyal member of the Enclave, a remnant of the pre-war United States government. [PAWN_pronoun] believed in the Enclave's mission to restore America to its former glory, even if it meant using ruthless methods. [PAWN_pronoun] was trained in advanced combat and technology, making [PAWN_objective] a formidable opponent in the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Bounty Hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took on the dangerous profession of hunting criminals in a largely lawless world. The transition between bounty hunter and mercenary was often smooth and unclear, but [PAWN_pronoun] to think of [PAWN_objective]self as a bringer of law, judge, jury and executioner.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Teacher
BackstoryDef.description: In a world were few had the time and means to educate themselves, [PAWN_nameDef] took it upon [PAWN_objective]self to teach the children of [PAWN_possessive] community how to write, read and count as well as anything else [PAWN_pronoun] could find old books about. History, however, was a subject [PAWN_nameDef] avoided, too little did [PAWN_pronoun] know about it and too depressing were the few scraps of knowledge [PAWN_pronoun] managed to paste together.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Quack
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wasn’t among the most honest people wandering around the wasteland. [PAWN_pronoun] made a living traveling from one backwater settlement to the next, selling elixirs and concoctions of wondrous qualities, or so [PAWN_pronoun] claimed… It was quite important that [PAWN_pronoun] already left a settlement before its inhabitants caught on to the scheme.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Hooker
BackstoryDef.description: Unlike other aspects of life before the great war, like sanitation or education, prostitution remained a staple of post-war economy. [PAWN_nameDef] didn’t chose [PAWN_possessive] profession out of desire, but out of need, as it proved to be a comparatively easy way to get by. Sure, [PAWN_pronoun] had to deal with stingy and intrusive costumers every once in a while, but it surely beat scrounging around in some ghoul-infested ruins for supplies, at least for [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Mayor
BackstoryDef.description: While most smaller settlements in the wasteland were ruled over by the town’s sheriff, some of the larger one’s had a mayor, who may or may not have been elected democratically. [PAWN_nameDef] was one of those mayors and while [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed the benefits of the office, [PAWN_pronoun] deeply cared for the members of [PAWN_possessive] community.

BackstoryDef.title: Daring Explorer
BackstoryDef.description: The wasteland was, without question, an extremely dangerous place. However, many Adventurers like [PAWN_nameDef] dared to explore the ruins of the past. Partially out of curiosity, partially for the profit that could be made. Many ruins of the old world lured with treasures and [PAWN_pronoun] was determined to answer their call.

BackstoryDef.title: Holodisk Librarian
BackstoryDef.description: As the old world burned in the fires of nuclear devastation, most of the knowledge humanity gathered over the centuries was lost forever. One of the few relatively reliable sources of knowledge were holodisks, which proved to be resilient enough not only to survive the great war, but many decades of nuclear fallout too. [PAWN_nameDef] made it [PAWN_possessive] life goal to gather and preserve as much of the once lost knowledge of the world before the war. [PAWN_pronoun] preferred to leave the dangerous work of obtaining the disks to mercs and spent most of [PAWN_possessive] time analysing and cataloguing the contents of dusty holodisks.

BackstoryDef.title: Diner Chef
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated a small diner next to a road bustling with trade. [PAWN_pronoun] was happy to provide a warm meal and a place to sleep to any paying customers, as long as they didn’t start any trouble.

BackstoryDef.title: Brotherhood Deserter
BackstoryDef.description: The strict and military lifestyle of the Brotherhood wasn’t for everyone. While [PAWN_nameDef] was born into the Brotherhood of Steel, it didn’t take [PAWN_objective] long to realise that this kind of life just wasn’t for [PAWN_objective]. One night, while on guard duty, [PAWN_pronoun] left [PAWN_possessive] post to never return. [PAWN_nameDef] had some troubles adapting to a “civilian” life, but [PAWN_pronoun] had to keep a low profile and hope that [PAWN_possessive] former brothers and sisters wouldn’t catch [PAWN_objective]. Desertion wasn’t taken lightly by the Brotherhood of Steel.

BackstoryDef.title: Implant Expert
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the few remaining experts on performance enhancing implants left in the world. This made [PAWN_objective] an incredibly valuable asset for [PAWN_possessive] community. However, no one really knew where [PAWN_pronoun] obtained [PAWN_possessive] knowledge about the almost lost art of cybernetic enhancements. [PAWN_nameDef] never really talked about [PAWN_possessive] past.

BackstoryDef.title: Co-op Gardener
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a gardener in a cooperative agricultural project. [PAWN_pronoun] and his fellow co-op members tended to a communal garden and evenly split the yield. While it was tedious work, the harvest was usually enough to not only feed all the members, but to sell the surplus on a nearby market.

BackstoryDef.title: Greaser
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] once found pre-war magazines about the greaser culture and old holodisks with rock music. This proved to be quite the formative experience, as [PAWN_pronoun] never left this phase behind and continued to live [PAWN_possessive] life the greaser way. Keep it cool, Daddy-O!

BackstoryDef.title: Orphaned Wanderer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] parents were killed by raiders when [PAWN_pronoun] was still a child. Leaving [PAWN_possessive] all alone in the world. Despite the odds, [PAWN_pronoun] managed to grow into adulthood. The wasteland is a harsh and unforgiving place, and few have internalized its lessons as well as [PAWN_nameDef].

BackstoryDef.title: Child Entrepreneur
BackstoryDef.description: From a very young age, [PAWN_nameDef] has had an entrepreneurial spirit, collecting scrap and knick-knacks and either selling or exchanging whatever [PAWN_pronoun] could find with others.

BackstoryDef.title: Curious Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a very curious child. [PAWN_pronoun] was fascinated with every aspect of the vast wasteland, perhaps more so than was good for [PAWN_objective]. While this curiosity often put [PAWN_nameDef] into dangerous situations, it provided [PAWN_objective] with precious knowledge about the creatures of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Bully
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was always a little taller and stronger than [PAWN_possessive] peers, a useful trait in the unforgiving wasteland. [PAWN_pronoun] used [PAWN_possessive] impressive stature to boss around others and take whatever [PAWN_possessive] wanted. Unfortunately, [PAWN_pronoun] wasn’t among the brightest and most gifted children.

BackstoryDef.title: Apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been adopted by a skilled craftsman and started to learn [PAWN_possessive] trade from a young age. However, [PAWN_pronoun] never finished [PAWN_possessive] apprenticeship, as [PAWN_pronoun] started to travel the world and roam from town to town, despite the dangers of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: BB Gun Crack shot
BackstoryDef.description: As a child [PAWN_nameDef] found an old but functional BB Gun. [PAWN_pronoun] often practiced shooting for many hours and became a capable Shot, a skill most valuable in the hostile wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Ruin Dweller
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a ruined pre-war building somewhere in the vast wasteland. [PAWN_pronoun] had to constantly clear away rubble and debris to create more space for living. However, the constant danger of collapsing roofs made [PAWN_objective] nervous and shaky, impairing [PAWN_possessive] fine motor skills.

BackstoryDef.title: Gas Station Inhabitant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up around a reinforced gas station. While it may not have been the most glamorous accommodation, the station was secure enough to grant [PAWN_objective] an unharmed childhood and [PAWN_pronoun] learned a thing or two about the old world from the advertising posters and brochures.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on the road. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up with a caravan travelling from settlement to settlement. From a very young age [PAWN_nameDef] learned the art of bartering and looking after the caravan’s brahmin.

BackstoryDef.title: Street Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised on the streets of a settlement somewhere in the wasteland. From a very young age [PAWN_pronoun] had to take care of [PAWN_objective]self and the fact [PAWN_pronoun] made it to adulthood at all showed [PAWN_possessive] tenacity.

BackstoryDef.title: Cannibalistic Youth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a community of cannibals. As [PAWN_nameDef] was used to this unsavoury diet from a young age, it took a long time until [PAWN_pronoun] recognized the depraved nature of [PAWN_possessive] community. Once [PAWN_pronoun] realized it, [PAWN_pronoun] quickly left the group. [PAWN_nameDef] was haunted by [PAWN_possessive] past and had troubles interacting with other people.

BackstoryDef.title: Cryostasis Child
BackstoryDef.description: The day the bombs fell, a selected few were put into cryostasis chambers and survived the following nuclear apocalypse unharmed. [PAWN_nameDef] was one of these people who endured the decades and centuries in cryostasis. While [PAWN_pronoun] had many skills, which were rare in the postapocalyptic wasteland, [PAWN_pronoun] also knew little to nothing about the societies which have emerged since the Great War.

BackstoryDef.title: Wild Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up alone in the wilds. [PAWN_possessive] only companions were animals and [PAWN_pronoun] never learned to write and read. While [PAWN_pronoun] was in contact with other humans since [PAWN_possessive] time in the wilds, [PAWN_pronoun] still has no social skills whatsoever, but few inhabitants of the wasteland knew so much about survival in the wilderness as [PAWN_pronoun] did.

BackstoryDef.title: Stung by Radscorpion
BackstoryDef.description: While playing in the wastes as a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was attacked and stung by a radscorpion. While [PAWN_pronoun] managed to survive both the attack itself and the poison injected into [PAWN_objective], [PAWN_pronoun] remained weakened for a long time. At least [PAWN_pronoun] learned a lot about animals and medicine during this painful experience.

BackstoryDef.title: Eco-Cultist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by a devoted cult. The cult aimed to form the largely barren wasteland into a paradise of green splendour. To further this goal all cultists were experts in tending to plants and animals. However, the cult was far from pacifistic, as the green patches the members cared for attracted a great number of scavengers, bot humans and beasts. Thus, [PAWN_nameDef] learned both gardening and herding as weel as fighting when [PAWN_pronoun] was young.

BackstoryDef.title: Whorehouse Kid
BackstoryDef.description: Prostitution proved to be not only one of the oldest businesses of humanity, but also one of the most resilient. The practice survived the apocalypse and thrived in the wasteland. [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the surroundings of a brothel. While this upbringing might have been dubious in nature, it was also relatively safe, as brothels and whorehouses were usually well guarded and defended. [PAWN_pronoun] learned a lot about human nature and their interactions with each other while observing the clients.

BackstoryDef.title: Gambler's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: As a child of a passionate gambler [PAWN_nameDef] was used to a roving lifestyle, as [PAWN_possessive] parents often changed their place of residence. Usually, the family stayed in the same place as long as there were casinos or people to exploit and hastened off quickly as soon as the victims grew angry enough to resort to violence. While [PAWN_nameDef] never was much of a book learner, [PAWN_pronoun] was cunning and sly.

BackstoryDef.title: Child Sheriff
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a settlement where only children lived. The other kids looked up to [PAWN_objective], both figurately and literally, as [PAWN_pronoun] was one of the oldest children. Therefore, it was [PAWN_possessive] duty to ensure the safety of the town’s inhabitants. After [PAWN_pronoun] reached a certain age [PAWN_pronoun] had to, like it was custom, leave the town and make a living someplace else.

BackstoryDef.title: Surviving Mormon
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was one of the few survivors of the sacking of New Canaan. The Canaanites, as they were often called by outsiders, were known as skilled crafters and honest traders who knew how to defend themselves. However, after [PAWN_pronoun] witnessed the slaughter of [PAWN_possessive] people [PAWN_nameDef] vowed to never take up arms again.

BackstoryDef.title: Advanced Student
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was fortunate enough to receive an advanced education while [PAWN_pronoun] was a child. Thise made [PAWN_objective] somewhat of an oddity among the unwashed and illiterate masses of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Livestock Herder
BackstoryDef.description: Like many others, [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] family made a living through a small herd of cattle, mostly brahmin they herded. While this may not have been the most exciting childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] rarely had to go hungry for an extended period of time.

BackstoryDef.title: Nomad Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up as part of a nomadic clan, which followed around herds of semi-domesticated cattle. While [PAWN_nameDef] learned a lot about living off the land, [PAWN_pronoun] never lived within a major settlement and had lacked many skills the city folk was known for.

BackstoryDef.title: Abducted by Aliens
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] claimed to have been abducted by aliens while [PAWN_pronoun] was a child. Of course, [PAWN_pronoun] never managed to come up with actual proof of this tall tale, but [PAWN_possessive] startling descriptions of the aliens called zetans and their malevolent experimentation on humans made sure most other people preferred to keep their distance from [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Swamp Dweller
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a reclusive community located in a nearly impassable swamp area. The manifold dangers of the swamp, mostly pockets of toxic or radioactive mist and the monsters that lurked within them, ensured only the hardiest people survived to adulthoodac. [PAWN_nameDef] had to fight the horrors of the swamp from a young age but had little time for education or creative activities.

BackstoryDef.title: Pit Refugee
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] fled from the area known as the pit. The pit was a, even by the standards of the wasteland, nightmarish industrial landscape, where only the most abhorrent creatures could survive. On top of that the area was ruled over by a band of bloodthirsty raiders who enslaved the local population forced them to toil around blast furnaces to smelt precious metal night and day. No wonder, [PAWN_nameDef] fled.

BackstoryDef.title: Greenhorn
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on a remote farmstead. Early on in [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_pronoun] began to dream about a life far away from the dull and demanding farm work. Soon after, [PAWN_nameDef] set out to make it in the big city.

BackstoryDef.title: Megaton Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born within Megaton, one of the largest settlements within the capital wasteland. While the city was relatively safe from outside threats such as raiders and mutated wildlife, the dormant atomic warhead located at the heart of the settlement posed a significant threat itself. However, like most of Megaton’s inhabitants, [PAWN_nameDef] got used to the ghastly landmark.

BackstoryDef.title: Rivet City Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised in Rivet City in the capital wasteland. Rivet City was a town located deep within the belly of a stranded aircraft carrier which made it one of the safest settlements the known wasteland. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up enjoying significantly more safety and security than most children, which in turn led to underdeveloped combat skills.

BackstoryDef.title: Children of Atom Novice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to a couple of cultists of the Children of Atom. This bizarre cult revered a deity called Atom and thought that an atomic explosion was the holy act of their deity to create new life. Naturally, most wastelanders frowned upon, or outright despised the cult, as they knew the perils of radiation all too well.

BackstoryDef.title: Diamond City Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the “green jewel” of the commonwealth wasteland, Diamond City. Protected by the near impenetrable walls of the largest settlement in the commonwealth, [PAWN_nameDef] enjoyed a relatively safe and happy childhood, visiting the local school and spending [PAWN_possessive] free time practicing hitting things with [PAWN_possessive] trusty baseball bat.

BackstoryDef.title: Novac Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised in Novac, one of the smaller settlements of the Mojave wasteland. While Novac did not have the mighty walls of New Vegas, nor the raw military power of the NCR to count on, its watchful citizens still made it one of the safer places to live. Plus, there were dinosaur souvenirs.

BackstoryDef.title: Westside Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has seen things no child should see during [PAWN_possessive] upbringing in the outer districts of New Vegas. Westside always was a cesspool of vice and violence and unlike many others [PAWN_nameDef] survived long enough to get out of it, albeit it left its marks on [PAWN_objective]. [PAWN_pronoun] learned a thing or two from the local gang, the Kings.

BackstoryDef.title: Goodsprings Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in Goodsprings, in the Mojave wasteland, aptly named so for its relative abundance of clean drinking water. While Goodsprings wasn’t really well defended, its remote location ensured that few dangers threatened the town. This lack of excitement (or mortal dangers, depending on perspective) was too dull for [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_pronoun] decided to leave as soon as [PAWN_pronoun] was coming of age.

BackstoryDef.title: Trapper Offspring
BackstoryDef.description: While most of the remaining wildlife of the wasteland was extremely dangerous, not to mention irradiated, the general scarcity of foodstuffs ensured that their meat was in high demand. [PAWN_nameDef]’s parents made a living from trapping various smaller animals with shoddy contraptions, a trade which was rightfully viewed as a less dangerous method than hunting.

BackstoryDef.title: Primm Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the city of Primm, a settlement south of New Vegas. While the town did have casinos of its own, it never managed to reach the glamour of the New Vegas strip. Still, the occasional caravan and gambler on the way to the strip ensured the town’s moderate wealth.

BackstoryDef.title: Tribal Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into one of the numerous tribal societies which have emerged in the wasteland. What the tribe lacked in terms of technology and organisation it made up for in ingenuity and adaptability. These traits ensured, that the tribe managed to eke out a living where others would have perished.

BackstoryDef.title: Gunslinger Juvie
BackstoryDef.description: In [PAWN_possessive] youth [PAWN_nameDef] found an old revolver while scavenging in some ruins. Inspired by tales of the gunslingers of the old world, [PAWN_pronoun] took up the iron and began practicing.

BackstoryDef.title: Frontier Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on the very frontier of human civilisation, such as it is. Thanks to its remoteness, the region was relatively free of radiation and the absence of larger settlements or trade routes made it unpopular for raiders. However, this also meant that everything had to be built from scratch, since there were little to no ruins to scavenge.

BackstoryDef.title: Displaced Child
BackstoryDef.description: War and strife were commonplace, even after the apocalypse. [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] family were refugees, fleeing from one of the countless conflicts that arose in the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Born Miner
BackstoryDef.description: While most of the earth’s natural resources were depleted before the great war, there still were a few mines in operation in the wasteland. The scarcity of raw materials ensured, that these mines were of great strategic value for whoever was in control of them. [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the vicinity of one of those last mines and spent much of [PAWN_possessive] youth digging for ore.

BackstoryDef.title: Apothecary's Apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: In [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_nameDef] worked for a local pharmacist as an assistant. While the remedies they produced were much less effective compared to a stimpak or other pre-war medicine, the overall lack of medical supplies in the wasteland, paired with the numerous dangers that lurked within it ensured that they never lacked customers.

BackstoryDef.title: Entitled Youth
BackstoryDef.description: Through some means, probably illegal or unsavoury in nature, [PAWN_nameDef]’s parents became wealthy enough to afford a lifestyle most wastelanders only could dream about. [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed an above average education and luxuries most others would have deemed lavish. This also meant, that [PAWN_pronoun] never had to care for [PAWN_objective]self and abhors the thought of doing tasks which [PAWN_pronoun] deemed beneath [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Drug Courier
BackstoryDef.description: During [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a drug courier for a syndicate of the local organised crime. The drug dealers used the fact that children are mostly left alone and rarely under the superstition of transporting illegal or highly valuable goods. While this certainly was not the best upbringing a child could hope for, [PAWN_nameDef] learned valuable skills during this time.

BackstoryDef.title: Junior Mechanic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up around a shop operated by a group of mechanics. They quickly realized how gifted [PAWN_nameDef] was and took [PAWN_objective] in. [PAWN_pronoun] learned a lot about the miracle work of the mechanics namely, how to keep machinery in an operational state without a reliable source of spare parts.

BackstoryDef.title: Little Lamplight Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the hidden settlement of Little Lamplight, deep within the capital wasteland. Only children were allowed to life in this peculiar settlement, as everyone had to leave after they reached the age of sixteen. [PAWN_nameDef] learned a lot about plant care during [PAWN_possessive] time in Little Lamplight, as the townspeople mainly ate mushrooms that grew in the cave it was located in.

BackstoryDef.title: Goodneighbour Juvie
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born and raised in the settlement of Goodneighbour in the commonwealth. The town was rough and [PAWN_nameDef] had to learn early in life who [PAWN_pronoun] could trust to avoid getting shanked. It was a tough youth, but it made [PAWN_objective] even tougher.

BackstoryDef.title: Shopkeeper's Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born as the child of shopkeepers. Early on [PAWN_pronoun] learned about trade and bartering. Since the small settlement, their shop was located in had no security forces to speak off, [PAWN_pronoun] too had to learn how to scare of thieves and other rascals.

BackstoryDef.title: Aspiring Treasure Hunter
BackstoryDef.description: As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] fled from the area known as the pit. The pit was a, even by the standards of the wasteland, nightmarish industrial landscape, where only the most abhorrent creatures could survive. On top of that the area was ruled over by a band of bloodthirsty raiders who enslaved the local population forced them to toil around blast furnaces to smelt precious metal night and day. No wonder, [PAWN_nameDef] fled.

BackstoryDef.title: Merc's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born as the child of a wasteland mercenary. While [PAWN_possessive] parent trade ensured [PAWN_nameDef] rarely had to go hungry for an extended period of time, [PAWN_pronoun] was well aware that the dangers of the merc life could very well leave [PAWN_objective] orphaned. Despite this, [PAWN_nameDef] took after [PAWN_possessive] parent and started to fire, clean, and modify all the guns [PAWN_pronoun] could get [PAWN_possessive] hands on.

BackstoryDef.title: Relic Hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Raiders killed [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother when [PAWN_pronoun] was young, and [PAWN_possessive] gunsmith father disappeared from [PAWN_possessive] life not long after. [PAWN_pronoun] has always believed he simply walked away. In truth, he died chasing one last deal, trying to leave [PAWN_objective] something. Now [PAWN_pronoun] chases the most dangerous scores in the wasteland alone, and prefers it that way.

BackstoryDef.title: Left to Fend
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to strip and clean a rifle at [PAWN_possessive] father's workbench, a skill that outlasted the man who taught it once he disappeared.

BackstoryDef.title: Ghoulified Outfitter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] once ran packages for an underground network moving people out of harm's way. These days [PAWN_pronoun] runs a shop instead, stocked deep with surplus gear that customers rarely seem to want, and spends the slow hours reading anything [PAWN_pronoun] can find about what waits on the other side.

BackstoryDef.title: Pre-War Childhood
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s memories of before the bombs are faded now, worn smooth by two centuries, but [PAWN_pronoun] still remembers the smell of a corner shop and being told to mind the register.

BackstoryDef.title: Rebuilt Security Chief
BackstoryDef.description: A new face, a new set of memories, and a badge were all it took to bury who [PAWN_nameDef] used to work for. [PAWN_pronoun] runs the gate with a hard-nosed discipline that's earned real respect, whatever [PAWN_pronoun] actually is underneath it.

BackstoryDef.title: Borrowed Memory
BackstoryDef.description: The childhood [PAWN_nameDef] remembers belonged to somebody else first. [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't examine it too closely, and neither does anyone who values [PAWN_possessive] friendship.

BackstoryDef.title: Night Shift Commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the night shift and doesn't have time to pretend otherwise to anyone who stops [PAWN_objective] to talk. [PAWN_pronoun] buried a husband who wore the same badge, and threw everything left into being the officer he would have wanted watching [PAWN_possessive] back.

BackstoryDef.title: Deckhand's Daughter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up running errands between the Hangar Deck and Upper Deck, and never forgot which side actually did the work.

BackstoryDef.title: Museum Curator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] inherited a museum of pre-war relics from [PAWN_possessive] parents and never left it since. [PAWN_pronoun] talks to the exhibits more than to people, and honestly prefers it that way.

BackstoryDef.title: Raised Among Relics
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up dusting display cases instead of playing outside, and could recite the provenance of every artifact in the collection before [PAWN_pronoun] could tie [PAWN_possessive] own shoes.

BackstoryDef.title: Saloon Girl
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works the floor of a settlement bar, trading company and conversation for caps from anyone willing to pay. [PAWN_pronoun] has heard every secret worth knowing and forgotten none of them, though [PAWN_pronoun] rarely lets on which ones matter.

BackstoryDef.title: Bar Regular's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up underfoot in a settlement tavern, running drinks between tables and learning which regulars to smile at and which to avoid.

BackstoryDef.title: Underground Innkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps a bed-and-breakfast running for travelers who'd otherwise sleep in the open, decades after the world that built [PAWN_objective] burned down. [PAWN_pronoun] treats every guest like family, whether they deserve it or not.

BackstoryDef.title: Shelter Survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode out the bombs crammed into a public fallout shelter with strangers who became the only family [PAWN_pronoun] had left.

BackstoryDef.title: Settlement Doctor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patches up everyone who stumbles into [PAWN_possessive] clinic and ends up running the whole settlement in the process, since nobody else wants the job. Sharp-tongued and endlessly busy, [PAWN_pronoun] treats bullet wounds and bruised egos with equal bluntness.

BackstoryDef.title: Orphaned Caretaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a settlement of orphaned kids with no adults to rely on, patching up scraped knees and worse long before anyone taught [PAWN_objective] how.

BackstoryDef.title: Frontier Markswoman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps [PAWN_possessive] small town's gecko problem in check with a rifle and a loyal dog at [PAWN_possessive] side. [PAWN_pronoun] has a plain, patient way of teaching newcomers how to survive out here without getting them killed.

BackstoryDef.title: Small Town Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up chasing geckos out of the vegetable patch with a switch, long before anyone trusted [PAWN_objective] with a real gun.

BackstoryDef.title: Frontier Doctor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has pulled more bullets out of more people than [PAWN_pronoun] can count, working out of a converted house with steady hands and an old man's patience. [PAWN_pronoun] treats anyone who stumbles through the door, no questions asked.

BackstoryDef.title: Apprentice Sawbones
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth handing tools to the town healer, memorizing which herbs stopped bleeding and which just smelled like they should.

BackstoryDef.title: Saloon Matriarch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took over the local saloon years back and never left, pouring drinks and mothering every stranger who wanders in whether they want it or not. The whole town leans on [PAWN_objective] more than it admits.

BackstoryDef.title: Bar-Back's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up wiping down tables and breaking up squabbles between drunks twice [PAWN_possessive] size, learning early that a calm voice settles more fights than a fist.

BackstoryDef.title: Retired Prospector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent decades digging through the wasteland for anything worth selling, and settled down once [PAWN_possessive] knees gave out. [PAWN_pronoun] still keeps a stash of dynamite handy and a story ready for anyone who'll listen.

BackstoryDef.title: Claim Jumper's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tagged along on [PAWN_possessive] family's mining claims from the time [PAWN_pronoun] could walk, learning to spot good ore and bad ground in equal measure.

BackstoryDef.title: Stranded Caravaneer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s caravan was ambushed on the road and scattered to the wind, leaving [PAWN_objective] holed up wherever [PAWN_pronoun] can find cover. [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't lost the trader's instinct for a fair deal, even while waiting out the danger.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan-Born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never had a hometown, just a rotation of trade routes and a family that taught [PAWN_objective] to read people before [PAWN_pronoun] could read letters.

BackstoryDef.title: Scorpion-Stung Local
BackstoryDef.description: Too many radscorpion stings to the skull left [PAWN_nameDef] a little scrambled, but [PAWN_pronoun] gets by fine on odd jobs and stranger theories about who's really in charge of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Scorpion Nest Dare
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] poked at a radscorpion nest on a dare and paid for it with more stings than anyone should walk away from. [PAWN_pronoun] walked away anyway, mostly.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Executive
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs a trading company's branch office with cold efficiency, cutting deals and cutting competitors with the same steady hand. [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't apologize for either.

BackstoryDef.title: Ledger Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to balance a caravan's books before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to ride one, and took to profit margins like other kids took to games.

BackstoryDef.title: Casino Boss
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] clawed [PAWN_possessive] way to running a casino through charm, nerve, and a willingness to put a bullet in anyone standing between [PAWN_objective] and a bigger score. The checkered suit is a costume; the ambition underneath it is not.

BackstoryDef.title: Street Hustler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to talk [PAWN_objective]self out of trouble and into other people's pockets before [PAWN_pronoun] hit [PAWN_possessive] teens, a talent that only sharpened with age.

BackstoryDef.title: Trading Post Keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has run the same little trading post for years, always good for a rare find if you know to ask. [PAWN_pronoun] never seems to run out of stock, and never explains why.

BackstoryDef.title: Shopkeeper's Shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up sweeping floors and stocking shelves in a family shop, learning the trade one customer complaint at a time.

BackstoryDef.title: General Store Keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the only store in a town too small for competition, stocking a little of everything and never quite enough of what people actually want. [PAWN_pronoun] knows every customer by name and every debt they owe.

BackstoryDef.title: Shopkeeper's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up restocking shelves and counting caps behind the family counter, learning the value of a fair price before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else.

BackstoryDef.title: Casino Floor Boss
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the day-to-day of a Strip casino while the owner is off doing whatever owners do, smoothing over trouble before it reaches the top floor. [PAWN_pronoun] can read a room of gamblers, thieves, and drunks in a single glance.

BackstoryDef.title: Strip Errand Runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran messages and small errands between casino floors as a kid, learning who to trust and who to just smile at instead.

BackstoryDef.title: Casino Lieutenant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] climbed the ranks of a casino's enforcement crew by staying useful and keeping [PAWN_possessive] own deals quiet. [PAWN_pronoun] smiles easily, but the nerves underneath never fully settle.

BackstoryDef.title: Streetwise Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up running with a rough crowd, learning to talk fast and throw a punch faster when the talking failed.

BackstoryDef.title: High Society Maitre d'
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the front of house for a luxury establishment with impeccable manners and a fixed, unreadable smile. Guests find [PAWN_objective] charming; the ones [PAWN_pronoun] takes a private interest in are never seen again.

BackstoryDef.title: Raised on Etiquette
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was drilled in manners and hospitality from an early age, taught that a polished smile opens doors a raised voice never could.

BackstoryDef.title: Radio Superfan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has listened to every episode of [PAWN_possessive] favorite pre-war radio serial more times than [PAWN_pronoun] can count, and built a working replica of its hero's signature weapon by hand. [PAWN_pronoun] just wishes [PAWN_pronoun] had the nerve to wear the costume [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Serial Devotee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] pressed [PAWN_possessive] ear to a cracked radio speaker every night for [PAWN_possessive] favorite show, memorizing lines [PAWN_pronoun] would repeat for decades after.

BackstoryDef.title: Ancient Shopkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was already old when the bombs fell, and two and a half centuries later [PAWN_pronoun] is still hawking guns, armor, and junk from behind the same counter. Nothing much surprises [PAWN_objective] anymore.

BackstoryDef.title: Last Pre-War Memory
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] remembers the world before the bombs only in fragments now, faded further with every decade [PAWN_pronoun] has outlived it.

BackstoryDef.title: Memory Den Hostess
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hosts a parlor where, for the right price, clients relive their happiest memories in vivid detail. [PAWN_pronoun] decides who gets in and who doesn't, and guards the secrets of the machinery as closely as the secrets of the clientele.

BackstoryDef.title: Stage-Struck
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up chasing the glamour of old stage performers, practicing a smile and a stance meant to hold a room's attention.

BackstoryDef.title: Salvage Trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up around trade caravans and never stopped believing there's no such thing as junk, only parts waiting for the right buyer. [PAWN_pronoun] machines and builds as much as [PAWN_pronoun] sells.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode with a trade caravan from town to town, taking apart broken gadgets at every stop just to see if [PAWN_pronoun] could put them back together.

BackstoryDef.title: Jovial Innkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs a bar and hotel with [PAWN_possessive] twin, pouring drinks with a booming laugh and a thick accent that gets thicker the more [PAWN_pronoun] has had. Everybody's favorite regular, whether they've met [PAWN_objective] once or a hundred times.

BackstoryDef.title: Twin Troublemaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] twin were inseparable and identically loud, splitting every chore and every prank right down the middle.

BackstoryDef.title: Quiet Innkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the rooms and the ledgers while [PAWN_possessive] twin handles the noise, content to let someone else hold the room's attention. [PAWN_pronoun] notices more than [PAWN_pronoun] ever says.

BackstoryDef.title: Twin's Shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] let [PAWN_possessive] louder twin take the spotlight and quietly kept track of everything that actually needed doing.

BackstoryDef.title: Mercenary Bodyguard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a name as hired muscle before settling into guarding one boss in particular, loyal to a fault once trust is earned. [PAWN_pronoun] handles trouble fast and rarely needs to ask questions first.

BackstoryDef.title: Hard Knocks
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to fight before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else, growing up in a settlement where loyalty was worth more than caps.

BackstoryDef.title: Gunsmith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took over the family gun shop from [PAWN_possessive] father and runs it with the same meticulous care, hand-tooling every weapon that leaves the counter. [PAWN_pronoun] raises a family on the trade and never sells a gun [PAWN_pronoun] wouldn't carry [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Workbench Apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up at [PAWN_possessive] father's gunsmithing bench, stripping and rebuilding old firearms before [PAWN_pronoun] was tall enough to see over the counter.

BackstoryDef.title: Junk Shop Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs a cluttered surplus shop and can fix almost anything scavenged and broken, though [PAWN_possessive] deep suspicion of everyone who walks in tends to sour the sale. [PAWN_pronoun] has accused more than one honest customer of being something they're not.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrap Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood taking apart broken machines and putting them back together, trusting gears and wiring more than the people around [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Tribal Statesman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built a scattered farming settlement into something that could actually defend itself, leading through raider raids and worse with a founder's stubbornness. [PAWN_pronoun] dreams of something bigger than a single town, though [PAWN_pronoun] rarely says so out loud.

BackstoryDef.title: Vault Descendant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born generations removed from the vault [PAWN_possessive] people once sheltered in, raised instead on dirt farming and the discipline it took to keep a settlement alive.

BackstoryDef.title: Honest Shopkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] inherited both a general store and a town's leadership, and runs each one the same way: fairly, and without patience for the criminals trying to squeeze the place dry. [PAWN_pronoun] has made enemies for it, and doesn't regret a single one.

BackstoryDef.title: Merchant's Son
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth traveling with trade caravans before settling back home to learn the family business from the ground up.

BackstoryDef.title: Casino Crime Boss
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs [PAWN_possessive] town's crooked casino with a smile and a knife behind [PAWN_possessive] back, and has spent years scheming to bury the one honest shopkeeper standing in [PAWN_possessive] way.

BackstoryDef.title: Card Sharp in Training
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to cheat at cards before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to lose gracefully, and never saw much reason to bother with the second lesson.

BackstoryDef.title: Wandering Mutant
BackstoryDef.description: Old-world radiation twisted [PAWN_nameDef] into something between ghoul and mutant, and left a sapling growing from [PAWN_possessive] skull that just keeps getting bigger. [PAWN_pronoun] has outlived more towns than [PAWN_pronoun] can name and still guides caravans through the worst of the wasteland.

BackstoryDef.title: Before the Bombs
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood belongs to a world that doesn't exist anymore, remembered now only in the vaguest, oldest fragments.

BackstoryDef.title: Ghoul Figurehead
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] styles [PAWN_objective]self the leader of [PAWN_possessive] underground ghoul community, though [PAWN_pronoun] answers to interests [PAWN_pronoun] would rather not name. [PAWN_pronoun] keeps the peace through sheer force of will and the occasional convenient lie.

BackstoryDef.title: Vault Refugee
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fled underground with [PAWN_possessive] family when the bombs fell, one of the last clear memories [PAWN_pronoun] has before the radiation changed everything.

BackstoryDef.title: Junkyard Mechanic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps a ghoul settlement's junkyard running through sheer mechanical stubbornness, coaxing life out of engines everyone else had given up on. Grubby, grease-stained, and sharper than [PAWN_pronoun] looks.

BackstoryDef.title: Scrapyard Prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took apart every broken machine [PAWN_pronoun] could find as a kid, and put most of them back together working better than before.

BackstoryDef.title: Independent Madam
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the finest gentleman's establishment in town, and has kept it independent of every crime family that's tried to swallow it whole. Beautiful, businesslike, and sharper than anyone gives her credit for.

BackstoryDef.title: City Charmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that charm opened doors that force never could, and spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood practicing exactly which smile worked on which stranger.

BackstoryDef.title: Crime Family Don
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs one of the city's two most powerful crime families, and means to drag it out of gang warfare and into legitimate power through whatever alliances it takes. Ruthless in service of ambitions bigger than the gutter [PAWN_pronoun] climbed out of.

BackstoryDef.title: Gutter Climber
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up running errands for gangsters twice [PAWN_possessive] age, and decided early that [PAWN_pronoun] would rather give orders than take them.

BackstoryDef.title: Backroom Chemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] cooks chems and tinkers with ordnance out of a cluttered backroom lab, selling to whoever pays and asking few questions about what they intend to do with it. [PAWN_pronoun] knows exactly how dangerous [PAWN_possessive] work is and does it anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: Curious Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] blew the eyebrows off [PAWN_possessive] own face more than once experimenting with scavenged chemicals, and never once considered stopping.

BackstoryDef.title: Shopkeeper and Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs a shop stocked with gear [PAWN_pronoun] tested personally, often on [PAWN_objective]self, in the name of a wasteland survival guide nobody asked for. Cheerful to a fault, and allergic to acknowledging danger.

BackstoryDef.title: Curious Tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took apart every appliance in the house by age ten, and only sometimes managed to put them back together.

BackstoryDef.title: Radio Voice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] broadcasts news, rumor, and opinion in equal measure from behind a wall of scavenged transmitter gear, using the signal to needle tyrants and rally the desperate alike.

BackstoryDef.title: Radio Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up listening to pre-war radio recordings on a hand-cranked salvage set, memorizing every DJ's cadence long before [PAWN_pronoun] ever spoke into a mic.

BackstoryDef.title: Smooth Schemer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dresses well, speaks smoothly, and plans in the long term, treating other people's towns as problems to be solved however proves most profitable.

BackstoryDef.title: Quiet Persuader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that a well-placed word did more work than a well-placed fist, and never looked back.

BackstoryDef.title: Indentured Bartender
BackstoryDef.description: Ghoulified and indentured to a bar owner who never lets [PAWN_objective] forget it, [PAWN_nameDef] pours drinks with a patience that isn't really patience, just exhaustion that learned to smile.

BackstoryDef.title: Barroom Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended bar before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to legally serve a drink, and never really did anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: Bar Owner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] owns the bar and most of what passes through it, trading information, drink, and favors to whoever can afford [PAWN_possessive] price. Sentiment has never once beaten out profit.

BackstoryDef.title: Smuggler's Errand Boy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up running errands for smugglers in exchange for protection, learning fast which favors were worth remembering.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Playboy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lives well by wasteland standards, in a home full of liquor, company, and stolen luxury, and has never once felt the need to apologize for any of it.

BackstoryDef.title: Carefree Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never much cared for chores, school, or authority, and grew into an adult who still doesn't.

BackstoryDef.title: Canterbury's Founder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built Canterbury Commons out of a caravan stop and a stubborn refusal to move on, founding it at twenty alongside [PAWN_possessive] sister Daisy. Daisy and her husband are both gone now, and [PAWN_pronoun] raises her boy while keeping the trade routes running through town.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan-Raised
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the back of a trade caravan, learning routes and rates before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else. By twenty [PAWN_pronoun] had saved enough to stop wandering and build something that would stay put.

BackstoryDef.title: Reclusive Tycoon
BackstoryDef.description: Kept alive for centuries by machines of [PAWN_possessive] own design, [PAWN_nameDef] directs vast operations from behind closed doors, trusting robots more than people and long-term plans more than either.

BackstoryDef.title: Precocious Engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built and rebuilt machines through a childhood that valued results over affection, and grew convinced [PAWN_pronoun] alone could see what was coming.

BackstoryDef.title: Hotel Proprietor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has run the same hotel through decades of the Strip's rise, doing the books, minding the guests, and outlasting most of the people who once looked down on the operation.

BackstoryDef.title: Hotel Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised behind a hotel counter, greeting guests before [PAWN_pronoun] could see over it.

BackstoryDef.title: Slaver Guild Boss
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built a slaving operation on fear and brute force, ruling over [PAWN_possessive] crew with an iron fist and demanding respect [PAWN_pronoun] never quite earned honestly. Crossing [PAWN_objective] tends to end badly for whoever tries.

BackstoryDef.title: Rough Upbringing
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that fear got results faster than kindness ever did, and never much bothered with kindness again.

BackstoryDef.title: Ailing Crime Patriarch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built a criminal empire decades ago and still runs it from behind a haze of labored breathing, older and frailer than the enemies who'd love to see [PAWN_objective] gone. What [PAWN_pronoun] lacks in strength [PAWN_pronoun] makes up for in patience and old grudges.

BackstoryDef.title: Family Business
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up learning the family trade from the ground up, absorbing every lesson about leverage, loyalty, and quiet threats long before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to give the orders [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Town Sheriff
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built this town out of a hole in the ground and has spent the years since keeping it standing, badge, gun, and grudging patience included.

BackstoryDef.title: Founder's Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up watching [PAWN_possessive] father argue settlers into staying instead of scattering, and picked up the same stubborn calm.

BackstoryDef.title: Sheriff's Boy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trails [PAWN_possessive] father around the settlement, badge-struck and certain [PAWN_pronoun]'ll wear one just like it someday.

BackstoryDef.title: Retired Caravaneer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked caravan routes for thirty years before finally settling down, and still remembers every trader who ever tried to shortchange [PAWN_objective]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan Brat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on the road between settlements and could talk a stubborn brahmin into moving before [PAWN_pronoun] could read.

BackstoryDef.title: Retired Caravan Guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent three decades walking beside caravans with a rifle and a bad attitude toward raiders, and never fully unlearned either habit.

BackstoryDef.title: Wagon Kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up riding in the back of a caravan wagon, learning to spot trouble on the horizon before the adults did.

BackstoryDef.title: Water Plant Handyman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has kept the water purifier running for longer than most residents have been alive, one patched pipe and cursed gasket at a time.

BackstoryDef.title: Tinkerer's Shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed the old plant workers around with a wrench too big for [PAWN_possessive] hands, determined to fix something before the day was out.

BackstoryDef.title: Wasteland Scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years picking the ruins clean to trade for caps, until a dead raiding party and an orphaned little girl changed what [PAWN_pronoun] was scavenging for.

BackstoryDef.title: Ruin Runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to read a collapsed building for what it might still be hiding before [PAWN_pronoun] learned much else.

BackstoryDef.title: Adopted Daughter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't remember much about the raiders who killed [PAWN_possessive] real parents, just the scavenger who found [PAWN_objective] afterward and never let go of [PAWN_possessive] hand again.

BackstoryDef.title: Retired Raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] burned, robbed, and killed [PAWN_possessive] way across the wasteland for years before deciding a bar stool suited [PAWN_objective] better than a shotgun.

BackstoryDef.title: Raider's Whelp
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a raider camp learning that the strongest hand kept the food, and never forgot the lesson.
